notes.title: Anniversary Sale - 80% off for the week!
notes.content:
To celebrate the 2 year anniversary of launching Pixels Guide to Staying Dead on Wednesday 20th July, we're having a week long sale starting Monday 18th. Grab the game while it's 80% off!

If you don't know what Pixels Guide to Staying Dead is: it's a shared screen party shooter where health doesn't end at 0, players go below 0 health and become skeletons. You need to use your maths skills, and the various weapons available, to get your opponents to exactly 0 health!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/ed195f9a7ca76448f5ab287b2db4929325cda1b1.png[/img]

Pixels Guide to Staying Dead features 6 maps and a wide range of customisation options allowing you to individually adjust Gender, Hair, Hat, Facial Hair, Eye Colour, Eyebrow Colour, Skin Colour, Top, Legwear and Shoes. This means Pixels Guide to Staying Dead has one of the most in depth character customisation in a 2D game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/6ea528e3ebccece17b4d3c4b6aeb9b3851ca06d3.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/c5ed1a22ce00547585b234061401c0290ffd8ca2.gif[/img]

Hope you enjoy!

Pattern Assembled Team

notes.title: Pixels Guide to Staying Dead Now Available!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that Pixels Guide to Staying Dead is now available on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/58c070f8a3d316e93d00a7e71238ecc8438a7f0a.png[/img]

Pixels Guide to Staying Dead is a game for up-to 4 players, you have to get your opponents to EXACTLY 0  health to kill them. Above 0, they're a human, and below 0, they're a skeleton.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/ed195f9a7ca76448f5ab287b2db4929325cda1b1.png[/img]

The game also features full character customisation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/c5ed1a22ce00547585b234061401c0290ffd8ca2.gif[/img]

There's 6 different maps to play on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/6ea528e3ebccece17b4d3c4b6aeb9b3851ca06d3.gif[/img]

The game can be played as a free-for-all, or played as a team game. Any empty slots can be filled with AI!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33607536/5aa11989cfc4f2b3999e089a4b64de25114a7c8b.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy Pixels Guide to Staying Dead!
